question.value: What physical processes govern fragmentation of cluster-forming clumps into cores across evolutionary stage and Galactic environment; this first paper presents the ALMAGAL survey, revised clump properties and a first morphology analysis of the 5 sigma 1.38 mm continuum

evidence.quote: Fundamental questions about the physics responsible for fragmenting molecular parsec-scale clumps into cores of a few thousand astronomical units (au) are still open
In this first paper, we present a complete review of the target clumps physical properties, with a first analysis of the morphological properties of the dust continuum emission.
The ALMAGAL Large Program (2019.1.00195.L) was approved in ALMA Cycle 7
The ALMA Band 6 217 to 220 GHz frequency range is ideally suited to provide access to
we observed the 1.38 mm continuum and lines toward more than 1000 dense clumps in our Galaxy
